item.title: Iceland declares ocean-current instability a national security risk
item.description:
📝 Iceland declares ocean-current instability a national security risk August M • Shutterstock. com Iceland has classified the potential collapse of a major Atlantic current system as a national security threat, citing new scientific warnings that such a change could radically alter the country’s climate and economy. CNN reported that scientists increasingly worry that warming temperatures and disrupted salinity levels are slowing the system.
🔗 Read more: https://www.dagens.com/news/iceland-declares-ocean-current-instability-a-national-security-risk

item.title: Testing Shows Automotive Glassbreakers Can't Break Modern Automotive Glass
item.description:
📝 However, modern safety regulations—specifically, the "Ejection Mitigation Rule" in the 2013 Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard 226 (FMVSS 226), mean that most manufacturers have transitioned to laminated glass for the side windows. It's true that not all automakers have switched over to laminated glass for the side windows; the FMVSS 226 law stipulates that you can get around it if you install elaborate side airbags that also prevent ejection. Some of them, like Chevy and BMW, have been using laminated glass since the '70s and '80s.
🔗 Read more: https://www.core77.com/posts/138925/Testing-Shows-Automotive-Glassbreakers-Cant-Break-Modern-Automotive-Glass

item.title: An Update on the Farphone's Battery
item.description:
📝 back to home an update on the farphone's battery 28/11/2025 earlier this week i shared the how-to for this website, which is running on an old smartphone folks on lobste. rs and hacker news pointed out the fire risk of keeping a lithium battery plugged in all the time french blogger korben even mentioned it in an article about the device the fairphone 2 being as modular as it is, it was trivial to open the phone, pop the battery out, and duct-tape the micro-usb charging cable to the phone to avoid accidental dos forty seconds later the farphone had booted and the web server was back up thank you lobsters, thank you hackers, you might have prevented a tragic server explosion built by louis merlin under the cc by-nc-sa 4.
🔗 Read more: https://far.computer/battery-update/

item.title: Major AI conference flooded with peer reviews written by AI
item.description:
